sentences.text: Helonetta was a bird belonging to the subfamily Anatinae, the family Anatidae, and the class Aves.
The species Helonetta brodkorpi was described by Emslie in 1992.
Helonetta lived during the Late Pliocene.
It existed from 4.7 to 1.4 million years ago, spanning the Zanclean to Calabrian ages.
Fossils are known from the Tamiami Formation of Florida.
